items.text: Ravens listed QB Lamar Jackson as a full participant in Wednesday's practice, his first full session since the ankle injury.
items.why: First full practice since high-ankle sprain 24 days prior; jogged onto field with ankle taped, threw and handed off comfortably.
items.implication: Strongly elevates return probability vs Bills; unlocks Ravens offense and pass-catchers.
items.opportunity: Full participation raises optimism for Week 8 availability after missing three games.

items.text: Texans placed WR Jaylin Noel on injured reserve due to a toe injury after claiming RB Emari Demercado.
items.why: Turf toe; expected to miss rest of season per reports. Corresponding roster move.
items.implication: Solidifies Nico Collins as clear WR1 with elevated routes/targets; opens secondary opportunities.
items.opportunity: Nico already led with 24 routes on 29 dropbacks; more target share without Noel.

items.text: Lions RB Jahmyr Gibbs (shoulder) listed as non-participant at Wednesday's practice.
items.why: Shoulder injury noted after awkward slide in Week 7 win; new designation on initial report amid rest for others.
items.implication: Monitor closely for Thursday; unexpected DNP raises short-term concern for RB1 usage vs Vikings.
items.opportunity: If limited/out, David Montgomery or others could see expanded carries/snaps.

items.text: Lions WR Amon-Ra St. Brown (ankle) listed as non-participant at Wednesday's practice.
items.why: Ankle from Week 7; coach planned sit Wednesday with return expected Thursday.
items.implication: Managed rest; low long-term concern but confirm Thursday participation for Week 8 start.
items.opportunity: Jameson Williams could see slight route/target bump if limited.

items.text: Jaxon Smith-Njigba ripping off 9 more actual fantasy points than opportunity implies despite losing Kubiak, few dynamic threats, shaded coverage, and stadium knowing where ball is going.
items.why: Elite efficiency and production vs opportunity metrics; special talent overcoming scheme/usage headwinds.
items.implication: Sustainable WR1 upside even in tougher environment; hold/start confidently.
items.opportunity: High YPRR and target quality continue to drive overperformance.

items.text: Zay Flowers leads NFL in yards per route run despite 64% targets from Huntley; Ravens 6th in YPP with Huntley on 50% snaps. Very excited for Declan Doyle offense with healthy Lamar.
items.why: Elite YPRR already; Lamar return multiplies efficiency and overall offense.
items.implication: Major WR upside spike with Lamar full; strong start/ROS boost.
items.opportunity: Higher target quality and scoring environment with dual-threat QB.

items.text: Ashton Jeanty epitome of high-value-touch thesis: arguably worst runner metrics (53rd EPA/play, last in YPC 3.1) yet fantasy RB13 full-PPR PPG via 9 inside-5 carries and league-leading 45 RB targets.
items.why: Volume of high-leverage touches (goal-line + targets) overrides poor efficiency/running metrics.
items.implication: Continue starting as RB2/flex; touch quality supports floor/ceiling despite inefficiencies.
items.opportunity: Inside-5 and receiving work provide elite fantasy leverage.
items.conflict: Efficiency data conflicts with volume thesis but HVT wins for fantasy.

items.text: Texans WR routes on 29 Stroud dropbacks: Nico Collins 24 (clear lead), Noel 15 (left early), others lower; Dell only 6 in return.
items.why: Dominant route share confirms alpha role; Noel exit/IR further concentrates.
items.implication: Nico locked as high-end WR1 with expanded opportunity post-Noel IR.

items.text: Sell Chris Olave or Jordyn Tyson? Prefer sell Olave; rather sell the unproven rookie.
items.why: Value in selling established but perhaps capped asset over unproven.
items.implication: Trade candidate if contending for upgrades; monitor NO offense.

items.text: Keeping it open on Sam LaPorta; could be in for a big day against Vikings defense sure to pressure Jared Goff.
items.why: Matchup vs pressure-heavy Vikes defense creates TE opportunity in Lions scheme.
items.implication: Viable TE1 start with upside; keep rostered/flex consideration.
items.opportunity: Increased targets if pressure forces quick throws/checkdowns.

items.text: Eagles placed RB Dameon Pierce on injured reserve and signed RB Jaydon Blue to the active roster.
items.why: Roster move confirmed; Pierce to IR.
items.implication: Removes depth handcuff; Saquon remains workhorse with less competition behind him.
items.opportunity: Saquon snap/carry security increases; Blue is new depth piece.

items.text: Silva and Levitan: time to move on and move forward with Jonah Coleman in DEN backfield.
items.why: Pod discussion on DEN backfield post-return; push for Coleman as lead.
items.implication: Waiver priority and potential RB2/flex if role expands vs Dobbins/Harvey.
items.opportunity: Snap/rush/route share growth in DEN offense.

items.text: Lions full-PPR PPG dominance: Goff QB2, Gibbs RB1 (3.9 clear of next), St. Brown WR4, LaPorta TE6, Jameson Williams WR24 amid defensive woes and talent concentration.
items.why: Concentration of talent + schedule/defensive issues driving elite scoring rates.
items.implication: Prioritize Lions skill players in rankings/start decisions despite midweek DNPs.
items.opportunity: High snap/route/target shares in productive offense.
items.conflict: Midweek DNP for Gibbs/St. Brown creates short-term uncertainty.
